claim.statement: For the stated smooth genus-3 curve H over GF(8), #Jac(H)(GF(8)) = 486.
claim.scope: exact fixed polynomial-basis GF(8) source curve only
claim.evidence_kind: implementation-separated exhaustive extension point count and zeta reconstruction

base_field.element_encoding: polynomial-basis bits, least-significant bit is the constant coefficient

checks: d^2=b and d is nonzero in GF(8)
the affine v-derivative is u^2; at u=0 the u-derivative is d, so there is no affine singularity
in the infinity chart t=1/u and w=v/u^4, w^2+t^2*w=t+t^4+d*t^7 is smooth at t=w=0
s=v/u^2 gives s^2+s=u^3+1+d/u^3 with two order-3 poles; the Artin-Schreier genus formula gives genus 3

method.point_count: For n=1,2,3, enumerate every (u,v) in GF(8^n)^2 satisfying the exact source equation and add its unique rational point at infinity.
method.extension_construction: Use independently checked irreducible binary polynomials and an explicitly checked root of z^3+z+1 in each extension.
method.zeta_reconstruction: Set S_n=8^n+1-N_n, apply Newton identities through n=3, then apply the genus-3 functional equation c[6-i]=8^(3-i)c[i].
method.jacobian_order: For a smooth projective curve over GF(8), #Jac(H)(GF(8))=P(1), where P is the zeta numerator.

implementation_separation.shared_input: the public field and curve equations

provenance.canonical_uid_rule: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON(record) with recursively sorted keys, no insignificant whitespace, ensure_ascii=false

limitations: This certifies only the cardinality 486 of the stated Jacobian over GF(8).
It does not certify the Jacobian group structure, the A/B presentation, divisor reduction, addition, scalar multiplication, or enumeration of reduced representatives.
It does not certify the cover map, arbitrary-class pushforward, norm homomorphism, pull-push composition, kernel fibers, or subgroup preservation.
It does not generalize to another field representation, source curve, cover, or catalog row.
The replay is a separate implementation but has not received an external CAS replay or independent reviewer signature.
